title: Minimum Increments for Uniqueness
summary: Return the fewest +1 operations needed to make all values distinct.
statement: Return the fewest +1 operations needed to make all values distinct. Implement `minimum_increments_unique` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: In sorted order, the cheapest legal placement is one above the previous placement.
Place each value at max(original, next_allowed) and accumulate its movement.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the minimum_increments_unique invariant is complete.
Editorial: Place each value at max(original, next_allowed) and accumulate its movement. The intended bounds are O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
